text:
zoe: hey team, i'm the new oncall rotator starting my first night shift next Tue (overnight). quick questions: are there different expectations for night P1s/P0s vs daytime? who do i escalate to for anything that looks like sensitive data exposure? also where's the shortest runbook for 'data-leak' triage? trying to not be the person to accidentally notify 1000 people.
marc: welcome zoe :wave: good Q. night expectations: primary ack still 5m if it's a true P0 impacting live customers, but for ambiguous security/data issues we treat as P1 and give 10m ack window while we gather evidence. escalate to oncall-sre and notify the security rotation.
felix: for sensitive data exposure specifically, page @legal and @security immediately after initial triage. we have a special exec-notify hold for data leaks until legal confirms wording. runbook (short): https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall/data-leak-quickstart (one-pager). excerpt: ```1) preserve logs (do not restart services) 2) snapshot affected instances 3) collect sample payloads into secure bucket (kms:Encrypt only) 4) page security + legal```
zoe: who exactly is on the legal pager and how do i page them? i don't want to DM the wrong person at 2am.
priya: legal pager is `legal-team@pagerduty.com`. add the `legal-escalation` contact method in PD profile. when paging, use the tag `data-leak` so their playbook picks it up. i'll DM you the PD id.
zoe: thanks. second Q: during night, is it okay to escalate to next-tier SRE instead of waking the assigned infra lead? what's the recommended escalation chain after 10m?
marc: recommended chain: primary -> 10m escalate to oncall-sre -> 20m page infra lead + eng-managers -> 30m exec notify. for night, if primary can't reach infra lead use the pager escalation policy (it will page whoever is on-call next). avoid paging execs unless legal signs off for data exposures.
opsbot: OpsBot: To run a local pager test (VPN + SSO required): 
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/v1/pager/test -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"user":"zoe","mode":"push"}'
```
If you receive 403 or 401, see https://docs.redwood.com/oncall/access-troubleshoot.
zoe: ran the curl and got 200. push received. also confirmed my phone has SMS fallback enabled.
felix: small but important note: for any suspected customer PII leak, do NOT instruct engineers to delete logs or rotate keys until security/legal say so. we need chain-of-custody.
zoe: copy that. last thing: any recommended prep for the night shift before first rotation?
priya: do the dry-run sim (we run a night sim Fri 02:00PT). review the data-leak quickstart, confirm PD contacts + KMS decrypt access, and have your laptop with corp VPN + `aws sso login` ready. i'll add you to the sim invite.
opsbot: OpsBot: Pager test log 1830001111 - delivered via push to zoe; status: delivered; ack: none.
zoe: appreciate it all 60a i'll join the night sim and follow the runbook. less nervous now :thumbsup:
